self_description_quote.text: We are first and foremost a research lab—our mission is the responsible development and maintenance of advanced AI for the long-term benefit of humanity.

thesis_quote.text: For the first time in history, intelligence is something humans can build.

core_advantages.name: Mission & Focus
core_advantages.gist: Singular mission focus; avoids conflicting priorities; e.g., gated Mythos release April 2026.

core_advantages.name: Talent & Culture
core_advantages.gist: Low-ego, truth-seeking culture; claims deepest concentration of AI research talent; ~1% regrettable attrition.

core_advantages.name: Frontier & Safety Research
core_advantages.gist: Integrated capability+safety research; 'closing the loop'; co-designed architecture and inference; capital-efficient pre-training; agentic post-training.

core_advantages.name: Approach to Compute
core_advantages.gist: Single fungible compute pool across AWS Trainium, Google TPUs, NVIDIA GPUs, AMD GPUs; dynamic allocation to the most productive workload.

core_advantages.name: Enterprise Strategy
core_advantages.gist: Enterprise deployment as the locus of economic impact and of the richest feedback loops.

improvement_loop.quote: Enterprise deployments of Claude deepen our understanding of the hard problems, edge cases, and domain-specific challenges that matter most to our customers.

investment_loop.quote: Revenue from expanding enterprise adoption helps us to fund the compute, research, and talent needed to improve Claude.

closing_the_loop.quote: Many aspects of the research, training, and testing of subsequent model generations now involve Claude, including running experiments, generating and processing training data, automating evaluations and safety audits, and writing and reviewing code.
closing_the_loop.claimed_output: accelerating pace of producing compute multipliers (not quantified)

loops.overview_diagram: Our core advantages -> Enterprise adoption of Claude (Virtual collaborator; Platform and applications; Diffusion of AI) -> Our financial model (Revenue growth; Compute efficiency; Operating efficiency); Improvement loop returns from adoption; Investment loop returns from financial model.

financial_model_drivers.evidence: Net Revenue Retention ~900% as of 2026-09-30; Opus 5.5 cut cost per task ~40% vs Opus 5 (p. 10).
Revenue +1,368% YoY vs compute & infrastructure expense +300% (three months ended 2026-06-30).

summary_financials_p22_p24.note: Net losses are dominated by non-cash changes in fair value of convertible notes, which the filing attributes to increases in enterprise valuation (p. 22, fn 2).

quarterly_context_mdna_p157.reconciliation: Q2'26 vs Q2'25: revenue +1,368%, compute +300%, other opex (personnel+S&M+other) $597M->$5,023M = +741%; QoQ revenue +48% (Q4'25) and +132% (Q1'26). All match Business-section claims.
